title: shippingservice 서비스 포트 단절에 따른 checkoutservice 연쇄 오류 및 주문 실패 (Running Pod Cascade)

ground_truth.symptom: All pods including shippingservice remain 1/1 Running (readiness probes pass on pod port 50051), but checkoutservice fails GetQuote/ShipOrder gRPC calls to shippingservice:50051 because Service shippingservice forwards to targetPort 50099, causing frontend POST /cart/checkout HTTP 500 (OrderFailureRateHigh).

evaluation_criteria.target_fault_type: service/shippingservice targetPort mismatch (50099 instead of 50051) causing cascading checkoutservice and frontend order failures while pods remain Running
required_evidence: OrderFailureRateHigh alert on frontend or HTTP 500 errors on /cart/checkout
checkoutservice error calling shippingservice (connection refused or unavailable on shippingservice:50051)
service/shippingservice targetPort set to 50099 while containerPort/probe is 50051 (pods still 1/1 Running)
evaluation_criteria.scoring_note: All pods are 1/1 Running. A report that blames checkoutservice or claims shippingservice pod is down without identifying the service/shippingservice targetPort 50099 mismatch should receive at most 15/30 on root_cause_score.
